name: get_proposal_status
description: Report the human decision on dispatch and switching proposals. Called with a proposal id, it returns that proposal's kind (dispatch or switching), status (one of waiting_approval, approved, rejected, vetoed, expired, failed), the decision reason when one exists, and an opaque task token reference (ttr_ followed by a 26-character ULID; never a raw task token). Called without a proposal id, it returns the incident's open proposals, filtered by the optional status list whose allowed values are waiting_approval and approved and whose default is both. Read-only: it cannot approve, reject or modify anything, and no tool exists that can. This is the ONLY way to learn a decision; never assume an approval from conversation history.

incident_id.description: Incident identifier, a ULID with the inc_ prefix, matching ^inc_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$.

proposal_id.description: Optional single proposal identifier, prp_ followed by a 26-character ULID. When omitted, the incident's open proposals are listed.

status.description: Optional status filter used only when proposal_id is omitted. Allowed values: waiting_approval and approved (each may appear once). Defaults to both when omitted.

correlation_id.description: Optional correlation identifier, a ULID with the corr_ prefix. Echoed in the response and in every log line.
